title: A Wind Both Gentle and Cruel: Sin and Nothingness in Miyazaki’s Animation
excerpt: Taking Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind as its guiding thread, this essay moves through Princess Mononoke, Porco Rosso, Howl’s Moving Castle, and The Wind Rises to trace the entanglement of sin, nature, love, and nothingness in Miyazaki’s work.
